parts.text: An online password consists of 2 different capital letters (from A to Z) followed by 3 different digits (from 0 to 9). Find the number of possible passwords.

parts.label: b

parts.text: An ice-cream shop in Murree sells 8 different flavours. Find the number of ways of choosing 3 different flavours.

parts.text: A school council of 5 members is to be chosen from 6 teachers and 5 students. Find the number of councils that contain at least 3 students.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Mr and Mrs Khan are among the 12 people and refuse to serve together. Find the number of committees with at least 2 women that do not contain both of them.

parts.text: Show that ⁿC₂ + ⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾C₂ = n² for n ≥ 2.

parts.text: A delegation of 5 students is chosen from 4 students from Lahore, 5 from Karachi and 3 from Islamabad. Find the number of delegations with no restrictions.

parts.label: b

parts.label: c
parts.text: Find the number of delegations that contain more students from Karachi than from Lahore.

parts.text: 4 boys are chosen from 7 boys and 3 girls are chosen from 5 girls. The 7 chosen children then stand in a row so that no two girls are next to each other. Find the number of ways this can be done.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Find the values of a and b.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Find the value of a.

parts.label: b

parts.text: (x + 1) and (2x − 1) are both factors of 2x³ + ax² + bx − 3. Find the values of a and b and hence write the cubic as a product of three linear factors.

parts.text: Find the values of a, b and c.
